dedupe_keys.name: laboratory feeder overload validation measurements for hospital power studies

description: This repository publishes a laboratory electrical-feeder series for physical overload validation in hospital-power research. It contains 360 chronological samples at one-minute spacing, spanning 08:00 to 13:59 on 13 February 2025. The documented capacity reference is 8 kW, with 39 overload-labelled samples grouped into twelve event identifiers. CSV fields include measured active power, capacity, per-unit loading, normalised ramp rate, operating regime and event labels. A data dictionary and preprocessing notes accompany the measurements. The repository owner identifies the material as laboratory data, not patient information or direct measurements from a clinical hospital feeder; geographic coverage is one laboratory whose location is not established. Access is public and free to inspect. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. A limitation is that original timestamp strings repeat: the supplied chronological timestamps were reconstructed from the first timestamp and elapsed minutes. The linked Zenodo DOI is still a placeholder. Simulation uses include overload-warning validation and testing threshold behaviour. It relates to data-building-data-genome-2, which the study separately uses for public building observations. No measurements or model software were downloaded.
